text:
QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(...)` itself, so initialising it installs the heap as the process-wide allocator. When `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is enabled it installs mutex-wrapped variants."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says mutex-wrapped variants are installed when MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is enabled. It never says a plain pair is installed otherwise, and it never says the choice is made at compile time inside the init function.
